meta.description: Plan how to earn customer trust and appropriate access. Use when credibility, permissions or AI policy constrain the engagement.

copy.tagline_en: Plan how to win client trust and secure the right access

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读任务上下文契约与方法文档,基于你提供的已授权信息,规划如何赢得客户信任并取得恰当访问权限;区分实现、验证、部署与验收,缺失能力如实报告。
howto.when: 当可信度、权限或 AI 政策限制合作时触发;若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前已脱敏的数据包与范围,不重启初始化或已有问答。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and method doc, then plans how to earn customer trust and appropriate access from your permitted context, separating implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance and reporting missing capabilities honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when credibility, permissions or AI policy constrain the engagement. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or discovery.

say_en.text: Help me plan how to earn this customer's trust and get the right access
say_en.note: Reads the context contract first, then drafts a plan

say_en.text: The customer worries about our use of AI — how should we respond?
